scenes.title: Connect training to a realistic job
scenes.subtitle: Section 6 / Targeted responses
scenes.sourceNote: Non-randomised comparison, with a predominantly PMET sample; participants with fewer than three months of employment records at their placement company were excluded. Singapore’s estimated results do not predict outcomes for Hong Kong retail workers.
scenes.reviewQuestion: Does this emphasis and pacing support the spoken argument?

scenes.title: Start with the proposed work or move
scenes.subtitle: Section 6 / Targeted responses
scenes.sourceNote: The evidence does not establish routine failure or a universal ranking of care, housing and childcare needs. The relevant arrangement depends on the person’s proposed work or move.
scenes.reviewQuestion: Does this emphasis and pacing support the spoken argument?

scenes.title: Practical advice. Referrals. Peer contacts.
scenes.subtitle: Section 6 / Targeted responses
scenes.sourceNote: The commissioned help covers eligible GBA Youth Employment Scheme participants. Programme provision is not universal coverage or proof of outcomes, and does not establish that all other households lack support.
scenes.reviewQuestion: Does this emphasis and pacing support the spoken argument?

scenes.title: Follow outcomes. Build on existing evidence.
scenes.subtitle: Section 6 / Targeted responses
scenes.sourceNote: An agency/provider-facing proposal using existing data first. Records are not assumed accessible or linkable. Hong Kong–Shenzhen requires particular-change comparisons; Singapore–Johor can establish a pre-RTS reference point. Before/after improvement alone is not causal evidence; distinguish RTS, JS-SEZ and other changes.
scenes.reviewQuestion: Does this emphasis and pacing support the spoken argument?

scenes.title: A different border. Two possible shifts.
scenes.subtitle: Section 7 / Singapore–Johor: two possible shifts
scenes.sourceNote: Different sovereign-border and legal arrangements. JS-SEZ designates geography in Johor; RTS is a separate project. Its February 2027 passenger-service target remains subject to safety certification and regulatory approvals.
scenes.reviewQuestion: Does this emphasis and pacing support the spoken argument?

scenes.title: Two forecast flows. Uneven exposure.
scenes.subtitle: Section 7 / Singapore–Johor: two possible shifts
scenes.sourceNote: Forecast additional annual spending flows, not realised effects, GDP losses or effects attributable to JS-SEZ. Rounded gross inputs subtract to S$294m; the source reports approximately S$290m, without implying greater precision.
scenes.reviewQuestion: Does this emphasis and pacing support the spoken argument?

scenes.title: Prepare; compare; adjust
scenes.subtitle: Section 7 / Singapore–Johor: two possible shifts
scenes.sourceNote: Eligibility and modalities differ; programmes are not RTS-specific measures. Prioritisation is a proposed focus, not a government commitment.
scenes.reviewQuestion: Does this emphasis and pacing support the spoken argument?

scenes.title: If travel became easier…
scenes.subtitle: Section 7 / Singapore–Johor: two possible shifts
scenes.sourceNote: Survey respondents, not one-third of all Singaporeans; buying a JB home and retiring there if travel improves. Sampling/question wording need verification before publication.
scenes.reviewQuestion: Does this emphasis and pacing support the spoken argument?

scenes.title: Help before and after a move
scenes.subtitle: Section 7 / Singapore–Johor: two possible shifts
scenes.sourceNote: Review does not mean entitlement expansion has occurred. GBA youth help is for eligible participants. Administrative entitlements cannot simply transfer across a sovereign border; no routine gap is assumed.
scenes.reviewQuestion: Does this emphasis and pacing support the spoken argument?

scenes.title: Whose experience will guide the response?
scenes.subtitle: Section 7 / Singapore–Johor: two possible shifts
scenes.sourceNote: Housing and service pressures are questions to monitor, not measured effects claimed here. Bilateral coordination is relevant where both governments must act; other issues can use existing organisations.
scenes.reviewQuestion: Does this emphasis and pacing support the spoken argument?
